item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
### Added (macOS) - **First-run welcome:** checks Git, connects an account, finds repositories in a folder you pick, and sets appearance and accent. Shown once, every step skippable, never shown to existing users. - **Repository statistics** (Repository > Statistics…): commits per week, contributors, hot and high-churn files, and who works in each folder. - **Pull Requests Across Repositories** (Hosting menu, ⌥⌘P): open pull requests from every open repository, split into Mine, Others and CI failing. - **Command line and links:** `gitwolf [folder]` (install it in Settings), `gitwolf://open?path=` links, and folders dropped on the Dock icon open as repositories. - **Notifications** when CI for the checked-out commit finishes while GitWolf is in the background (Settings to turn off). - **Undo** now switches back after a checkout and rewinds a whole rebase; a **Breaking Change** toggle in the commit helpers; **Copy Release Notes Since This Tag** on any tag. - **New wolf logo** (app icon, About window, Home screen, menu bar) and a **GitWolf blue** default accent. New About window and Help > Contributors. - **Install:** Homebrew (`brew install --cask ipuppyyt/gitwolf/gitwolf`, skips the Open Anyway step), a project website, and install steps in the README. - Provider errors now show the server's reason, with *Sign In Again* for browser sign-ins. Copy buttons confirm with "Copied".
### Added (Windows) - Provider accounts, pull requests and issues, notifications, safer sync and diff tools, matching the Mac app. - In-app updates (signed feed, verified before install), Open in editor/terminal, and custom actions. - CI: re-run, cancel and follow checks; a banner to open a pull request after a push. - Cached profile pictures, success notices, adjustable panel heights, a Copied confirmation, and tests and a build in CI.
### Changed - Menu bar: the new **Hosting** menu holds New Pull Request, New Issue, Notifications and Fork; the Repository menu is shorter. - CI lookups pause for five minutes after a host refuses them (rate limit), instead of retrying every few seconds. - Windows: trust is asked before hooks run, tokens are hidden in URLs, GitHub Actions are pinned, and the app is faster on large repositories.
### Fixed - The checks "re-run" button gave a vague error when no account was signed in. - The repository rail clipped tile badges. - Home screen buttons now share one size. - Changing the accent in the welcome sheet no longer restarts it.
